source.original_text:
Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang, arXiv2609.06905v1 Appendix A.1 (A.2), A1.E2 and the between-jump paragraph A1.SS1.p2.2, with nonaccumulation p3.7. The actual interval/live-record/elapsed adapter is an ASTIS completion of an implicit construction step, not a quotation or the full Proposition3.1.
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Fix any y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. Then for these fixed y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample, simultaneously: (i) for every finite nonnegative physical time t there exists exactly one n∈ℕ with T_n≤t<T_(n+1); (ii) for every such t and every index n satisfying those inequalities, there exists exactly one finite live record a=(s,z) such that record_n=inl(a), s≤t, and t−s<τ(z,ε_n), using nonnegative real subtraction and extended-valued comparison. In particular no stopped record supplies a phase, and when the next wait is infinite the last live record continues to cover every later finite physical time. Initialization index0 is retained and ε_n is source E_(n+1). Half-open intervals fix event-endpoint ownership; zero-length intervals are empty and strict positive waits are not an extra premise. This is the ASTIS interval/live-record/elapsed adapter needed by Appendix A.1's between-jump formula. It does not construct a global interpolated process, assert index(t=0)=0, or prove measurability, path regularity, full process uniqueness, Markov/invariance or costs.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun sample k => Real.toNNReal (sample k)
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →

        (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
    ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ᵐ sample ∂P,

        eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) →
        (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) →
        ∃! a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
          record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a ∧ a.1 ≤ t ∧
          ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef a.2 (ε sample n))

blind_reconstruction.text:
Let E be an arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space equipped with its Borel measurable structure (dimension zero is permitted). Let V:E->R be twice continuously differentiable, let alpha,beta be nonnegative reals, and let eta be real. Assume 0<alpha, alpha<=beta, 0<eta, beta*eta<=1, and, for every x,v in E,
alpha*||v||^2 <= D(DV)(x)[v][v] <= beta*||v||^2.
All inequalities involving alpha or beta as real scalars use their coercions to R.

On Omega=R^N put P=the countable product of rate-one exponential measures. Set e_k(omega)=max(omega_k,0), considered as a nonnegative real. For y,xRef in E, z=(q,p) in E x E, and real s, define
c=y-eta*grad V(xRef),
Phi(y,xRef,s,(q,p))=(c+cos(s)*(q-c)+(sqrt(eta)*sin(s))*p, (-sin(s)/sqrt(eta))*(q-c)+cos(s)*p).
For d=grad V(q)-grad V(xRef), define
S(xRef,(q,p))=(q,p-(2*<p,d>/||d||^2)*d),
rate(xRef,(q,p))=sqrt(eta)*max(0,<p,d>).
Division is the total real division of the literal Lean definitions; at d=0 the correction in S is zero.
For t>=0 set Lambda(y,xRef,z,t)=integral from 0 to t of rate(xRef,Phi(y,xRef,s,z)) ds, and define tau(y,xRef,z,e) as the infimum in nonnegative reals with infinity adjoined of {u>=0: Lambda(y,xRef,z,u)-e>=0}, with infinity when this set is empty.

For a nonnegative sequence e and initial z0 in E x E define records R_n in (R_nonnegative x (E x E)) disjoint-union Unit. Start with R_0=inl(0,z0). A stopped record inr remains inr. From R_k=inl(s,z), if tau(y,xRef,z,e_k)=infinity put R_(k+1)=inr; otherwise, writing w for this finite wait, put R_(k+1)=inl(s+w,S(xRef,Phi(y,xRef,w,z))). The code extracts w by untopD 0 only in the finite branch; its value zero at infinity is not used to make a live update. Define T_n as the stored time of a live record and infinity for a stopped record.

For every fixed y,xRef in E and every fixed z0 in E x E, for P-almost every omega, BOTH of the following hold, with records and times generated using e(omega):
(1) For every finite t>=0 there exists exactly one natural number n such that T_n<=t<T_(n+1).
(2) For every finite t>=0 and every natural n, if T_n<=t<T_(n+1), there exists exactly one a=(s,z) in R_nonnegative x (E x E) such that R_n=inl(a), s<=t, and the finite nonnegative elapsed time t-s, embedded into the extended nonnegative reals, is strictly less than tau(y,xRef,z,e_n).
The subtraction t-s in (2) is NNReal subtraction, which is truncated in general; the asserted s<=t makes it ordinary nonnegative elapsed time. An infinite next wait is allowed and every finite elapsed time is strictly below it. A stopped record has T_n=infinity and cannot satisfy T_n<=finite t. Equal adjacent event times make an empty half-open interval; strict wait positivity is not an assumed premise or separately stated conclusion. The full-measure event can depend on y,xRef,z0: the statement does not put their universal quantifiers inside one common almost-everywhere event. No law of a random initial state, no global interpolated process, and no measurable selector is asserted.

theorem actual_fixed_reference_physical_time_cover
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    actual_fixed_reference_physical_time_cover_statement hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη := by
  classical
  let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
  let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun sample k => Real.toNNReal (sample k)
  let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
  let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
    (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
        (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
     (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
  let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
    (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
      ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
    Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
  let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
    MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
      (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
        Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
      (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
  let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
    match r with
    | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
    | Sum.inl a =>
      if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
        Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
          S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
  let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
    Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
  let eventTime : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
    fun y xRef z₀ e n => (record y xRef z₀ e n).elim
      (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
  change ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ᵐ sample ∂P,
    (∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∃! n : ℕ,
      eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
      (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1)) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ n : ℕ,
      eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) →
      (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) →
      ∃! a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
        record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a ∧ a.1 ≤ t ∧
        ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef a.2 (ε sample n))
  -- Exact deterministic initialization/monotonicity and guarded live-record updates.
  rcases ActualFiniteJumpRecursion.actual_fixed_reference_finite_jump_recursion
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη with
    ⟨_, hstep, _, _, _, htime, _, _, _, _⟩
  have hinput := ActualNonaccumulation.actual_fixed_reference_event_time_nonaccumulation
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  intro y xRef z₀
  filter_upwards [hinput y xRef z₀] with sample hgood
  have hzero : eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) 0 = 0 :=
    (htime y xRef z₀ (ε sample)).1
  have hmono : Monotone (eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample)) :=
    (htime y xRef z₀ (ε sample)).2
  constructor
  · -- The first clock strictly above t has an initialized finite predecessor.
    intro t
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (hgood.1 t)
    have hex : ∃ k : ℕ, (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) k :=
      ⟨N, hN N le_rfl⟩
    let k : ℕ := Nat.find hex
    have hk : (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) k :=
      Nat.find_spec hex
    have hkpos : 0 < k := by
      by_contra h
      have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos h
      rw [hk0, hzero] at hk
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (show (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) ≤ t from bot_le)) hk
    let n : ℕ := k - 1
    have hsucc : n + 1 = k := by dsimp [n]; omega
    have hlow : eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) := by
      apply le_of_not_gt
      exact Nat.find_min hex (by change k - 1 < k; omega)
    have hupp : (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) := by
      simpa only [hsucc] using hk
    refine ⟨n, ⟨hlow, hupp⟩, ?_⟩
    -- Monotonicity makes distinct half-open event intervals disjoint.
    intro m hm
    apply le_antisymm
    · by_contra h
      have hnm : n + 1 ≤ m := by omega
      exact (not_lt_of_ge ((hmono hnm).trans hm.1)) hupp
    · by_contra h
      have hmn : m + 1 ≤ n := by omega
      exact (not_lt_of_ge ((hmono hmn).trans hlow)) hm.2
  · -- A clock below finite t cannot be a stopped record.
    intro t n hlow hupp
    cases hr : record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n with
    | inr u =>
      have hevent : eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = ⊤ := by
        change (record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n).elim _ _ = ⊤
        rw [hr]
        rfl
      rw [hevent] at hlow
      exact False.elim ((not_le_of_gt (WithTop.coe_lt_top t)) hlow)
    | inl a =>
      have haClock : eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0) := by
        change (record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n).elim _ _ = _
        rw [hr]
        rfl
      have hat : a.1 ≤ t := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp (by
        rw [← haClock]
        exact hlow)
      refine ⟨a, ⟨rfl, hat, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · -- Infinite wait keeps the last live arc available at every finite offset.
        by_cases hwtop : τ y xRef a.2 (ε sample n) = ⊤
        · simp only [hwtop, WithTop.coe_lt_top]
        -- Finite wait: the actual next clock is a.time plus that same wait.
        · let q : ℝ≥0 := (τ y xRef a.2 (ε sample n)).untop hwtop
          have hq : (q : WithTop ℝ≥0) = τ y xRef a.2 (ε sample n) :=
            WithTop.coe_untop _ _
          have hn : record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) =
              Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 (ε sample n)).untopD 0,
                S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 (ε sample n)).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2)) :=
            ((hstep y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n).2 a hr).2 hwtop

candidate_publication_context.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Fix any y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. Then for these fixed y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample, simultaneously: (i) for every finite nonnegative physical time t there exists exactly one n∈ℕ with T_n≤t<T_(n+1); (ii) for every such t and every index n satisfying those inequalities, there exists exactly one finite live record a=(s,z) such that record_n=inl(a), s≤t, and t−s<τ(z,ε_n), using nonnegative real subtraction and extended-valued comparison. In particular no stopped record supplies a phase, and when the next wait is infinite the last live record continues to cover every later finite physical time. Initialization index0 is retained and ε_n is source E_(n+1). Half-open intervals fix event-endpoint ownership; zero-length intervals are empty and strict positive waits are not an extra premise.
